answer: Every agent enters the economy through one narrow inlet: a staking gate where each identity locks a deposit and must solve a fresh cipher puzzle tied to its public key before trading. A reputation mesa then records only verified work, so identities with no history earn nothing. Forging a thousand fakes means paying a thousand deposits and solving a thousand puzzles, while honest agents reuse one proven identity, so the attacker's cost scales linearly and the defender's stays flat.
